button.span: What electrical services does SM Traders provide?

div.p: SM Traders provides complete residential and commercial house wiring, switch/socket installation, distribution board setup, MCB/RCCB safety installation, LED lighting, fault diagnosis, and inverter/battery setup.

button.span: Do you install rooftop solar systems?

div.p: Yes, we offer complete rooftop solar installation support including site assessment, solar panel mounting structure setup, inverter connection, wiring, testing and commissioning.

button.span: Do you provide electrical repair and maintenance?

div.p: Yes, we offer troubleshooting for short circuits, electrical fault repair, preventive maintenance checks, and solar system performance inspections.
